name: PDF Tools
description: Layered PDF reading for the agent (ADR 0312/0313): pdfjs text extraction for digital pages, model-vision page images for scanned pages, optional MinerU OCR for the rest.
author: LaboFlow

agentTools.name: read
agentTools.description: Read a PDF document page by page. Digital pages return their text layer; image-only (scanned) pages return a model-visible page image when the current model has vision. `path` follows the Read rules (workspace-relative, absolute inside the session scratch, or an attachments reference). `pages` selects a 1-based window such as 5-12,30; defaults to the first window of a large document, so read the opening pages for structure and then pull targeted ranges instead of the whole file. `password` is needed only when the tool reports the document is encrypted - ask the user for it and retry. Scanned pages that cannot be imaged are parsed through the configured MinerU endpoint, if any. Always pass action: "read".

path.description: Existing PDF file; workspace-relative or explicitly approved.

pages.description: 1-based page window, for example 5-12,30. Defaults to the first window of the document.

password.description: Password for an encrypted PDF; supply on retry when the tool reports encryption.

settings.title: 解析通道 / Parsing backend

enum.label: MinerU 精准解析（官方云，需 Token）/ Precision (official cloud, token)
MinerU Agent 轻量解析（官方云，免 Token）/ Agent lightweight (official cloud, no token)
自定义 / 自建部署（手动填写）/ Custom endpoint (manual)

settings.description: 精准解析：表格/公式识别最全，需 Token，官方每日 1000 页高优先级额度。Agent 轻量解析：免 Token（按 IP 限速），速度最快，仅输出 Markdown。自定义：指向自建或其他部署，需暴露与官方 v4 相同的接口。/ Precision: richest tables & formulas, token required, 1000 priority pages/day. Agent lightweight: no token (IP rate-limited), fastest, Markdown only. Custom: your own deployment exposing the same v4 API.

settings.title: MinerU Token
settings.description: 精准解析：登录 mineru.net → 「API」页创建 Token 后原样粘贴；自定义部署填对应 Token。Agent 轻量解析无需填写。/ Precision: create a token at mineru.net → API page and paste it; custom: your deployment's token. Not needed for Agent lightweight.

settings.title: 服务基地址 / Base URL
settings.description: 只填基地址，例如 https://mineru.example.com——工具会自动追加 /api/v4/... 路径，不要粘贴完整接口 URL。/ Base URL only, e.g. https://mineru.example.com — the tool appends /api/v4/... itself; never paste a full endpoint URL.
